The package advertises itself as an 'HTTP probing tool for security researchers' but contains no HTTP-probing functionality. The duplicated install-time and import-time execution paths ensure code execution on the installer's Windows machine regardless of whether the package is installed or later imported by a consumer. The Microsoft-look-alike staging path, hidden+system attributes, no-window flag, and Tor-only delivery are all consistent with intent to persist an attacker-controlled binary on the developer's machine.
